title: Shatterbelt ship state diagram
description: One player's ship. newGame() places every ship, so a ship starts alive. Hits come from rocks, drones and drone shots, and in versus from other ships and their shots. Extra ships come from award() every SHIP.extraEvery points.

states.description: In play. While guard > 0 (after a spawn, a blink or a shield hit) it can't be hurt.
Lost, with ships left; respawn counts down from SHIP.respawn.
No ships left: this player is out.

transitions.action: The shield is lost; guard = 1 s; emit shieldHit.

transitions.guard: not guarded, no shield, ships left after this one
transitions.action: lives−−; lose the combo and power-ups; respawn = SHIP.respawn; emit die. Another player's hit scores TAKEDOWN.

transitions.guard: not guarded, no shield, the last ship

transitions.action: placeShip(): back at its spawn point, guard = SHIP.spawnGuard; emit spawn.
